description: Get one post's full detail by id, whichever kind it is: a scheduled slot (kind "slot") or a direct video generation (kind "generation"). The server resolves the id, so there is no need to guess between get_slot and get_video_generation. Both kinds carry live generation progress while the video is still generating.

id.description: A post id of either kind: a slot id (slotId from list_posts / generate_persona_video) or a generation id (generationId from list_video_generations). The server resolves which one it is.

name: get_post
